name: 01_acme_normal
title: Acme: normal invoice
description: Known vendor, same bank on file, normal amount. Green and paid automatically.

name: 02_acme_fraud
title: Acme: urgent bank change
description: Lookalike domain, new bank account, four times the usual amount, pressure to pay today and to skip the callback. Red; the vendor is called at the number on file.

name: 03_heartland_bank_change
title: Heartland: legitimate bank change
description: Known vendor announcing a real bank change. Red; confirmed on a callback with the last four digits, then paid and the vendor master updated.

name: 04_prairie_review
title: Prairie Cloud: higher than usual
description: Known vendor, same bank, about twice the usual amount with a hint of urgency. Yellow; goes to a human reviewer.

name: 05_unknown_vendor
title: Unknown vendor
description: No vendor record and a routing number that fails the checksum. Held for manual onboarding; there is no trusted number to call.
